| P2-049 | IRT calibration. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **Logistic 2PL on a standard normal scale. An item needs 200 unique pilot persons and both outcomes before its a and b are written and marked calibrated. A later response from the same person replaces the earlier one. Fit is the RMS residual at that person's EAP ability. Scoring reads only calibrated parameters. The job runs when invoked, not on a cron.** | builder default |
| P2-050 | CAT placement. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **Logistic 2PL. Fewer than 8 calibrated items is provisional and unsure, with no ability. The person prior is standard normal. A tie takes the lower item id. The CEFR label is the band of the point estimate and does not replace the interval. Static questions stay uncalibrated, so the current onboarding result is unsure.** | builder default |
